WITH events_event_params_engagement_time AS (
SELECT
  _TABLE_SUFFIX AS event_date,
  event_timestamp,
  user_pseudo_id,
  -- canonicalize engagement_time_msec: prefer numeric fields if present; event_param.value may have int_value or double_value or float_value or string that parses
  (CASE
    WHEN ep.value.int_value IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ep.value.int_value AS FLOAT64)
    WHEN ep.value.double_value IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ep.value.double_value AS FLOAT64)
    WHEN ep.value.float_value IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ep.value.float_value AS FLOAT64)
    WHEN ep.value.string_value IS NOT NULL THEN SAFE_CAST(ep.value.string_value AS FLOAT64)
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS engagement_time_msec
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
  AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(1) AS distinct_pseudo_users_with_positive_7d_and_zero_2d
FROM (
  -- 7-day totals per user (2020-12-31 through 2021-01-07)
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(engagement_time_msec, 0)) AS engagement_7d_msec
  FROM events_event_params_engagement_time
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
) AS t7
LEFT JOIN (
  -- 2-day totals per user (2021-01-06 through 2021-01-07)
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(engagement_time_msec, 0)) AS engagement_2d_msec
  FROM events_event_params_engagement_time
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
) AS t2
ON t7.user_pseudo_id = t2.user_pseudo_id
WHERE t7.engagement_7d_msec > 0
  AND COALESCE(t2.engagement_2d_msec, 0) = 0

SELECT
  p.productSKU AS product_sku,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_quantity,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productRevenue, 0)) AS total_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  -- find sessions (fullVisitorId + visitId) that include the target product
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h2, UNNEST(h2.product) AS p2
    WHERE p2.v2ProductName = 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
      AND CONCAT(fullVisitorId, CAST(visitId AS STRING)) = CONCAT(fullVisitorId, CAST(visitId AS STRING))
  )
  -- exclude the product itself
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY
  product_sku,
  product_name
ORDER BY
  total_quantity DESC,
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  top_source AS traffic_source,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev_million) - MIN(monthly_rev_million)), 2) AS diff_million
FROM (
  SELECT
    trafficSource.source AS top_source,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX)) AS month,
    SUM(IFNULL(totals.transactionRevenue, 0)) / 1e6 AS monthly_rev_million
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
  GROUP BY
    top_source, month
),
(
  SELECT
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    SUM(IFNULL(totals.transactionRevenue, 0)) AS total_rev
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
  GROUP BY
    traffic_source
  ORDER BY
    total_rev DESC
  LIMIT 1
) top
WHERE
  top_source = top.traffic_source
GROUP BY
  top_source

WITH feb_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS session_date,
    device.deviceCategory AS device_category,
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL OR (h.transaction.transactionId IS NULL AND h.transaction.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL)) AS session_has_transaction,
    -- extract earliest transaction date per hit within the session (if any) and device for that hit
    ARRAY(
      SELECT AS STRUCT
        h.transaction.transactionId AS transaction_id,
        PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS transaction_date,
        device.deviceCategory AS transaction_device
      FROM UNNEST(hits) h
      WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL OR h.transaction.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY COALESCE(h.transaction.transactionId, '') -- keep order deterministic
    ) AS session_transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
first_visit AS (
  -- first session date in Feb per visitor
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(session_date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM feb_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  -- first transaction date in Feb per visitor and the device used for that first transaction
  SELECT
    fs.fullVisitorId,
    MIN(t.transaction_date) AS first_transaction_date,
    -- pick device associated with the earliest transaction_date; if multiple on same date pick any (MIN)
    ARRAY_AGG(t.transaction_device ORDER BY t.transaction_date, t.transaction_device LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS transaction_device
  FROM feb_sessions fs,
  UNNEST(fs.session_transactions) t
  GROUP BY fs.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT
  fv.fullVisitorId,
  DATE_DIFF(ft.first_transaction_date, fv.first_visit_date, DAY) AS days_between_first_visit_and_first_transaction,
  ft.transaction_device AS device_of_first_transaction,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft
  ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY days_between_first_visit_and_first_transaction, fv.fullVisitorId

SELECT
  top_source AS traffic_source,
  ROUND(max_daily_revenue/1e6,3) AS max_daily_revenue_million,
  ROUND(max_weekly_revenue/1e6,3) AS max_weekly_revenue_million,
  ROUND(max_monthly_revenue/1e6,3) AS max_monthly_revenue_million,
  ROUND(total_revenue/1e6,3) AS total_revenue_million
FROM (
  WITH hits_with_product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
      trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', _TABLE_SUFFIX) AS day,
      -- sum product revenue from hits.product.productRevenue (nullable)
      COALESCE(SUM(
        (SELECT SUM(IFNULL(p.productRevenue,0)) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS hit, UNNEST(hit.product) AS p)
      ),0) AS day_product_revenue
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    GROUP BY
      traffic_source, day
  ),
  total_by_source AS (
    SELECT
      traffic_source,
      SUM(day_product_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM hits_with_product_revenue
    GROUP BY traffic_source
  ),
  top_source_cte AS (
    SELECT traffic_source AS top_source, total_revenue
    FROM total_by_source
    ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  -- compute daily, weekly (7-day rolling), monthly (by calendar month) aggregates for the top source
  daily_and_rollups AS (
    SELECT
      h.day,
      h.traffic_source,
      h.day_product_revenue
    FROM hits_with_product_revenue h
    JOIN top_source_cte t
      ON h.traffic_source = t.top_source
  ),
  weekly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
      day,
      SUM(day_product_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS week_7day_revenue
    FROM daily_and_rollups
  ),
  monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
      day,
      SUM(day_product_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM day), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM day) ORDER BY day RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS month_revenue
    FROM daily_and_rollups
  )
  SELECT
    t.top_source,
    t.total_revenue,
    -- maximum single day revenue for top source
    (SELECT MAX(day_product_revenue) FROM daily_and_rollups) AS max_daily_revenue,
    -- maximum 7-day rolling revenue
    (SELECT MAX(week_7day_revenue) FROM weekly_revenue) AS max_weekly_revenue,
    -- maximum calendar-month revenue
    (SELECT MAX(month_revenue) FROM monthly_revenue) AS max_monthly_revenue
  FROM top_source_cte t
)

WITH classified_sessions AS (
SELECT
  -- identity columns (keep joinable)
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  -- original date string from GA (YYYYMMDD)
  date,
  -- calendar month in YYYY-MM (lifted logic: take first 6 chars of date and insert dash)
  CONCAT(SUBSTR(date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTR(date, 5, 2)) AS month,
  -- classify session: 'purchase' if session-level totals.transactions > 0 OR any hit-level item/product revenue > 0, else 'non-purchase'
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) > 0 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      -- check hit transaction revenue or hit.item.itemRevenue or product.productRevenue in nested arrays/structs
      WHERE (h.transaction.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
         OR (h.item IS NOT NULL AND (h.item.itemRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.item.itemRevenue AS INT64) > 0))
         OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p
           WHERE (p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
         )
    ) THEN 'purchase'
    ELSE 'non-purchase'
  END AS session_class,
  -- normalize pageviews: prefer session-level totals.pageviews, treat NULL as 0
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(totals.pageviews AS INT64), 0) AS pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
)
SELECT
  month,
  session_class,
  AVG(visitor_pageviews) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
FROM (
  -- sum pageviews per visitor within each month and session class
  SELECT
    month,
    session_class,
    fullVisitorId,
    SUM(COALESCE(pageviews, 0)) AS visitor_pageviews
  FROM
    classified_sessions
  WHERE
    month BETWEEN '2017-04' AND '2017-07'
  GROUP BY
    month,
    session_class,
    fullVisitorId
)
GROUP BY
  month,
  session_class
ORDER BY
  month ASC,
  -- ensure 'purchase' appears before 'non-purchase'
  CASE WHEN session_class = 'purchase' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  session_class

WITH session_level_base AS (
SELECT
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  CAST(visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  userId,
  visitNumber,
  visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  totals.visits AS totals_visits,
  totals.hits AS totals_hits,
  totals.pageviews AS totals_pageviews,
  totals.timeOnSite AS totals_time_on_site,
  totals.bounces AS totals_bounces,
  totals.transactions AS totals_transactions,
  totals.transactionRevenue AS totals_transaction_revenue,
  channelGrouping,
  trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
  trafficSource.medium AS traffic_medium,
  trafficSource.campaign AS traffic_campaign,
  device.browser AS device_browser,
  device.deviceCategory AS device_category,
  geoNetwork.country AS geo_country,
  geoNetwork.region AS geo_region,
  geoNetwork.city AS geo_city,
  socialEngagementType
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
),
hits_flat AS (
SELECT
  s.visitId,
  s.fullVisitorId,
  CAST(s.visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  s.userId,
  s.visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date) AS session_date,
  hit.hitNumber AS hit_number,
  hit.type AS hit_type,
  hit.time AS hit_time_ms,
  hit.hour AS hit_hour,
  hit.minute AS hit_minute,
  hit.isEntrance AS is_entrance,
  hit.isExit AS is_exit,
  hit.page.pagePath AS page_path,

  hit.eventInfo.eventCategory AS event_category,
  hit.eventInfo.eventAction AS event_action,
  hit.eventInfo.eventLabel AS event_label,
  hit.eventInfo.eventValue AS event_value,
  hit.transaction.transactionId AS hit_transaction_id,
  hit.transaction.transactionRevenue AS hit_transaction_revenue,
  hit.item.itemQuantity AS hit_item_quantity,
  hit.item.itemRevenue AS hit_item_revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit
),
sessions_by_user_rank AS (
SELECT
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  totals.transactionRevenue AS totals_transaction_revenue,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime DESC) AS rn_per_user,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime DESC) AS rnk_per_user
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
),
daily_aggregates_by_country_source AS (
SELECT
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) AS session_date,
  geoNetwork.country AS geo_country,
  trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
  trafficSource.medium AS traffic_medium,
  COUNT(1) AS sessions_count,
  SUM(totals.pageviews) AS sum_pageviews,
  SUM(totals.hits) AS sum_hits,
  SUM(totals.transactionRevenue) AS sum_transaction_revenue,
  AVG(totals.timeOnSite) AS avg_time_on_site
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127`
GROUP BY session_date, geo_country, traffic_source, traffic_medium
),
session_custom_dimensions_exploded AS (
SELECT
  s.visitId,
  s.fullVisitorId,
  CAST(s.visitorId AS STRING) AS visitor_id_string,
  s.visitStartTime,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date) AS session_date,
  cd.index AS cd_index,
  cd.value AS cd_value
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170127` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.customDimensions) AS cd
),
classified_sessions AS (
SELECT
  -- identity columns (keep joinable)
  visitId,
  fullVisitorId,
  -- original date string from GA (YYYYMMDD)
  date,
  -- calendar month in YYYY-MM (lifted logic: take first 6 chars of date and insert dash)
  CONCAT(SUBSTR(date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTR(date, 5, 2)) AS month,
  -- classify session: 'purchase' if session-level totals.transactions > 0 OR any hit-level item/product revenue > 0, else 'non-purchase'
  CASE
    WHEN SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) > 0 THEN 'purchase'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      -- check hit transaction revenue or hit.item.itemRevenue or product.productRevenue in nested arrays/structs
      WHERE (h.transaction.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
         OR (h.item IS NOT NULL AND (h.item.itemRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(h.item.itemRevenue AS INT64) > 0))
         OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p
           WHERE (p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
         )
    ) THEN 'purchase'
    ELSE 'non-purchase'
  END AS session_class,
  -- normalize pageviews: prefer session-level totals.pageviews, treat NULL as 0
  COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(totals.pageviews AS INT64), 0) AS pageviews
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
july_sessions_with_hits AS (
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  date,
  hits
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND ARRAY_LENGTH(hits) > 0
),
non_youtube_item_purchases_by_youtube_visitors AS (
SELECT
  s.fullVisitorId AS fullVisitorId,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  p.productQuantity AS item_quantity,
  s.date AS date
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160701' AND '20160731' -- July: lift literal here; adjust as needed
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(s.hits) AS h2, UNNEST(h2.product) AS p2
    WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(p2.v2ProductName, '')) LIKE '%youtube%'
  )
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(p.v2ProductName, '')) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
),
visitors_who_bought_youtube_products AS (
SELECT
  fullVisitorId
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hit,
  UNNEST(hit.product) AS product
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(product.v2ProductName, '')) LIKE '%youtube%'
GROUP BY
  fullVisitorId
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  SUM(item_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM
  non_youtube_item_purchases_by_youtube_visitors
WHERE
  product_name IS NOT NULL
  AND product_name <> ''
  AND item_quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  product_name
ORDER BY
  total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  next_page,
  MAX(time_on_home_seconds) AS max_time_on_home_seconds,
  COUNTIF(next_page IS NOT NULL) AS occurrences
FROM (
  SELECT
    hits.hitNumber AS home_hit_number,
    LEAD(hits.page.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) AS next_page,
    -- time on page for the /home hit: use time field (seconds into session) difference to next hit's time if available,
    -- otherwise use totals.timeOnSite (session duration) as an upper bound.
    CASE
      WHEN LEAD(hits.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) IS NOT NULL
        THEN (LEAD(hits.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber)
              - hits.time)
      WHEN totals.timeOnSite IS NOT NULL
        THEN totals.timeOnSite
      ELSE NULL
    END AS time_on_home_seconds
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS hits
  WHERE
    _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
    AND hits.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL
    AND STARTS_WITH(hits.page.pagePath, '/home')
    -- ensure we only consider the /home hit itself (could be multiple per session)
)
-- exclude cases where there is no next page (NULL) so we find the most common next page
WHERE next_page IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY next_page
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH session_classification AS (
SELECT
  fullVisitorId,
  visitId,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', SAFE_CAST(date AS STRING))) AS session_month,
  -- A session is a purchase if totals.transactions > 0 OR any hit has a transaction.transactionId (non-null/non-empty)
  (COALESCE(totals.transactions, 0) > 0
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
     WHERE SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionId AS STRING) IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(SAFE_CAST(h.transaction.transactionId AS STRING)) <> ''
   )
  ) AS is_purchase,
  -- prefer totals.pageviews when present, else sum of hit-level pageview indicators via hits.page (count of page hits)
  COALESCE(totals.pageviews,
    (SELECT COUNTIF(h.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h)
  ) AS pageviews
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
)
SELECT
  session_month,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN session_label = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END), 0) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor_purchase,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN session_label = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END), 0) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor_non_purchase,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN session_label = 'purchase' THEN num_visitors END), 0) AS num_visitors_purchase,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN session_label = 'non_purchase' THEN num_visitors END), 0) AS num_visitors_non_purchase
FROM (
  -- second aggregation: per month x label compute avg pageviews per visitor and number of visitors
  SELECT
    session_month,
    session_label,
    COUNT(*) AS num_visitors, -- one row per visitor_month_label from first agg
    AVG(visitor_month_label_pageviews) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM (
    -- first aggregation: per visitor x month x label sum pageviews
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      session_month,
      IF(is_purchase, 'purchase', 'non_purchase') AS session_label,
      SUM(pageviews) AS visitor_month_label_pageviews
    FROM session_classification
    WHERE session_month IN ('2017-06', '2017-07')
      AND pageviews IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      fullVisitorId,
      session_month,
      session_label
  )
  GROUP BY
    session_month,
    session_label
)
GROUP BY session_month
ORDER BY session_month ASC

SELECT
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(last_event_date, first_visit_date, DAY)) AS max_days_between_first_visit_and_last_mobile_event
FROM (
  -- Compute for each user: first visit date, last visit date and whether last visit was on mobile,
  -- and first transaction date and whether first transaction was on mobile.
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(MIN(visitStartTime))) AS first_visit_date,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(MAX(visitStartTime))) AS last_visit_date,
    -- whether the last visit (by visitStartTime) had any hit with device.isMobile = TRUE
    MAX(IF(visitStartTime = last_visit_starttime AND device.isMobile, 1, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId) AS last_visit_is_mobile,
    -- first transaction date per user (if any) determined by earliest hit.transaction.transactionId not null
    first_transaction_date,
    first_transaction_is_mobile
  FROM (
    -- flatten visits and hits to get per-hit transaction info and device at visit level
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      visitStartTime,
      device,
      -- detect if this hit has a transaction id
      (SELECT MIN(h.transaction.transactionId) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL) AS any_transaction_id_in_visit,
      -- earliest transaction timestamp in this visit (if any)
      (SELECT MIN(h.time) FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL) AS earliest_txn_time_in_visit
    FROM
      `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  ) AS visits_with_hit_info
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId)
  -- derive per-user first transaction by looking across visits
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- per user, find the earliest transaction visitStartTime + hit.time to compute date and device
    SELECT
      fullVisitorId,
      DATE(TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(MIN(visitStartTime) + MIN_hit_time)) AS first_transaction_date,
      -- determine if the visit holding that earliest transaction had device.isMobile = TRUE
      ANY_VALUE(device_is_mobile_for_first_txn) AS first_transaction_is_mobile
    FROM (
      SELECT
        fullVisitorId,
        visitStartTime,
        -- hit.time is seconds offset from visitStartTime; choose minimal positive
        earliest_txn_time_in_visit AS MIN_hit_time,
        device.isMobile AS device_is_mobile_for_first_txn
      FROM (
        SELECT
          fullVisitorId,

  SELECT
    id, latitude, longitude,
    -- Haversine distance: using COS/SIN with degrees converted via multiplication by PI()/180()
    -- distance in kilometers
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((latitude - 40.7128) * PI()/180 / 2), 2)
        + COS(40.7128 * PI()/180) * COS(latitude * PI()/180)
          * POWER(SIN((longitude - (-74.0060)) * PI()/180 / 2), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
  WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
),
nearest_station AS (
  SELECT id, latitude, longitude, distance_km
  FROM stations
  WHERE distance_km <= 50
  ORDER BY distance_km
  LIMIT 1
),
-- 2) get daily precipitation for 2016 from shards, filter unflagged (qflag IS NULL) and element='PRCP'
-- raw precipitation values are in tenths of mm, so divide by 10
prcp_daily AS (
  SELECT
    g.date,
    (g.value / 10.0) AS prcp_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*` AS g
  JOIN nearest_station ns
  ON g.id = ns.id
  WHERE g.element = 'PRCP'
    AND g.qflag IS NULL
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM g.date) = 2016
),
-- 3) classify days as rainy (>5 mm) or non-rainy (<=5 mm)
prcp_classified AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    prcp_mm,
    CASE WHEN prcp_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS rain_flag
  FROM prcp_daily
),
-- 4) compute daily trip counts from Citibike for 2016
citibike_daily AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(starttime) AS date,
    COUNT(1) AS trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
),
-- 5) join daily trips with precipitation classification; keep only days present in both datasets
joined AS (
  SELECT
    c.date,
    c.trips,
    p.prcp_mm,
    p.rain_flag
  FROM citibike_daily c
  JOIN prcp_classified p
  USING (date)
)
-- 6) compute average trips for rainy vs non-rainy days
SELECT
  rain_flag,
  COUNT(*) AS days,
  ROUND(AVG(trips), 2) AS avg_daily_trips
FROM joined
GROUP BY rain_flag
ORDER BY rain_flag

-- The population_by_country table in the schema has columns year_1960 .. year_2019. To get a 2020 population we sum relevant rows from population_by_country:
-- The user asked "based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data".
-- Because the provided table ends at year_2019, this query will use year_2019 as the most recent available population and treat it as the "2020 population" per the instruction to sum relevant entries.
WITH target_countries AS (
  SELECT 'United States' AS country_name, 'US' AS code UNION ALL
  SELECT 'France', 'FR' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'China', 'CN' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Italy', 'IT' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Spain', 'ES' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Germany', 'DE' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Iran', 'IR'
),

-- Get confirmed cases from JHU summary for date 2020-04-20, aggregated to country level
jhu AS (
  SELECT
    country_region AS country_name,
    SUM(confirmed) AS confirmed_2020_04_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary`
  WHERE date = DATE '2020-04-20'
  GROUP BY country_region
),

-- Normalize some country names from JHU to match World Bank country naming where needed
-- We'll map by common names for the target list; later we join using code or name matching.
jhu_mapped AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN country_name IN ('US', 'United States', 'United States of America') THEN 'United States'
      WHEN country_name IN ('Mainland China', 'China') THEN 'China'
      WHEN country_name = 'Iran (Islamic Republic of)' THEN 'Iran'
      WHEN country_name = 'Korea, South' THEN 'Korea, Rep.'
      ELSE country_name
    END AS country_name,
    confirmed_2020_04_20
  FROM jhu
),

-- Extract population for each country from population_by_country.
-- The supplied table contains years up to year_2019. We'll use year_2019 as the "2020 population" per note above.
pop AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    country_code,
    year_2019 AS population_2019
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE country IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran, Islamic Rep.')
),

-- Normalize World Bank country naming for Iran to match our target list
pop_mapped AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN country = 'Iran, Islamic Rep.' THEN 'Iran'
         WHEN country = 'United States' THEN 'United States'
         ELSE country END AS country_name,
    country_code,
    population_2019
  FROM pop
)

SELECT
  t.country_name AS country,
  COALESCE(j.confirmed_2020_04_20, 0) AS confirmed_as_of_2020_04_20,
  p.population_2019 AS population_2019_used_as_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(j.confirmed_2020_04_20, 0) * 100000.0, NULLIF(p.population_2019, 0)) AS cases_per_100k
FROM target_countries t
LEFT JOIN jhu_mapped j
  ON j.country_name = t.country_name
LEFT JOIN pop_mapped p
  ON p.country_name = t.country_name
ORDER BY confirmed_as_of_2020_04_20 DESC

WITH

  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2000_q1' AND '2000_q4'
  GROUP BY area_fips

q2018 AS (
  SELECT
    area_fips,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_month3_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2018_q1' AND '2018_q4'
  GROUP BY area_fips

-- join and compute percent change; filter to Utah counties using geo_us_boundaries.counties (state FIPS for UT = '49')
joined AS (

  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(a.area_fips, b.area_fips) AS area_fips,

-- Compute, for evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR' and condition_status_code = 1,
-- the state with largest average subplot size and largest average macroplot size
-- for years 2015,2016,2017. Uses population (for expansion & adjustment factors),
-- population_stratum / population_stratum_assign linking via stratum_sequence_number and plot_sequence_number,
-- and condition table for CONDPROP_UNADJ and PROP_BASIS.
WITH
-- relevant plots with year and state
plots AS (
  SELECT
    p.plot_sequence_number,
    p.plot_state_code AS state_code,
    p.plot_state_code_name AS state_name,
    p.plot_inventory_year AS inventory_year
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` p
  WHERE p.plot_inventory_year IN (2015,2016,2017)
),
-- population assign connects plots to strata (and to stratum_sequence_number)
assign AS (
  SELECT
    psa.plot_sequence_number,
    psa.stratum_sequence_number,
    psa.inventory_year,
    psa.state_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_stratum_assign` psa
  WHERE psa.inventory_year IN (2015,2016,2017)
),
-- grab stratum-level expansion & adjustment factors needed
stratum AS (
  SELECT
    ps.stratum_sequence_number,
    ps.inventory_year,
    ps.state_code,
    ps.expansion_factor,
    ps.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot AS adj_subp,
    ps.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot AS adj_macr
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_stratum` ps
  WHERE ps.expansion_factor IS NOT NULL
),
-- condition info: condition proportion unadjusted and proportion basis (PROP_BASIS),
-- and link to plot via plot_sequence_number. Filter condition_status_code = 1 and evaluation identifier via population/evaluation_type join
cond AS (
  SELECT
    c.plot_sequence_number,
    c.inventory_year,
    c.state_code,
    c.condprop_unadj,
    c.prop_basis -- PROP_BASIS indicates 'SUBP' or 'MACR'
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015,2016,2017)
),
-- population table may contain evaluation_type; filter evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR' and link via stratum_sequence_number
pop AS (
  SELECT
    p.stratum_sequence_number,
    p.inventory_year,
    p.state_code,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot AS adj_subp,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot AS adj_macr,
    p.evaluation_identifier,
    p.eval_unit_created_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  WHERE p.inventory_year IN (2015,2016,2017)
    AND SAFE_UPPER(p.evaluation_identifier::STRING) = 'EXPCURR' -- handle cases where evaluation identifier encodes type; if not present this will be harmless
),
-- If evaluation type is stored elsewhere (some datasets store evaluation type in population_stratum or a code),
-- we'll fallback by joining population_stratum to population_stratum_assign and population as above.
-- Combine assigns, strata/population, plots, and conditions to compute subplot and macroplot area per plot.
combined AS (
  SELECT
    pl.plot_sequence_number,
    COALESCE(pl.state_code, a.state_code, c.state_code, sp.state_code) AS state_code,
    COALESCE(pl.state_name, sp_state.state_name) AS state_name,
    pl.inventory_year,
    c.condprop_unadj,
    c.prop_basis,
    -- Prefer expansion/adjustment from population (pop) if available else from stratum table
    COALESCE(pop.expansion_factor, stratum.expansion_factor) AS expansion_factor,
    COALESCE(pop.adj_subp, stratum.adj_subp) AS adj_subp,
    COALESCE(pop.adj_macr, stratum.adj_macr) AS adj_macr
  FROM plots pl
  LEFT JOIN assign a
    ON pl.plot_sequence_number = a.plot_sequence_number
    AND pl.inventory_year = a.inventory_year
  LEFT JOIN pop
    ON a.stratum_sequence_number = pop.stratum_sequence_number
    AND a.inventory_year = pop.inventory_year
  LEFT JOIN stratum
    ON a.stratum_sequence_number = stratum.stratum_sequence_number
    AND a.inventory_year = stratum.inventory_year
  LEFT JOIN cond c
    ON pl.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND pl.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` sp_state
    ON pl.plot_sequence_number = sp_state.plot_sequence_number
),
-- compute subplot area and macroplot area per plot according to rules:
-- Subplot Area = expansion_factor * condprop_unadj * adj_subp when prop_basis = 'SUBP' and adj_subp > 0
-- Macroplot Area = expansion_factor * condprop_unadj * adj_macr when prop_basis = 'MACR' and adj_macr > 0
per_plot_area AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    state_name,
    plot_sequence_number,
    -- guard against nulls
    SAFE_MULTIPLY(SAFE_MULTIPLY(expansion_factor, condprop_unadj), adj_subp) AS subplot_area,
    SAFE_MULTIPLY(SAFE_MULTIPLY(expansion_factor, condprop_unadj), adj_macr) AS macroplot_area,

  FROM combined

-- For subplot we only consider rows where prop_basis = 'subp' and adj_subp > 0 and expansion_factor & condprop_unadj present
valid_subplot AS (
  SELECT inventory_year, state_code, state_name, subplot_area
  FROM per_plot_area
  WHERE prop_basis = 'subp'
    AND subplot_area IS NOT NULL
    AND subplot_area > 0
),
valid_macroplot AS (
  SELECT inventory_year, state_code, state_name, macroplot_area
  FROM per_plot_area
  WHERE prop_basis = 'macr'
    AND macroplot_area IS NOT NULL
    AND macroplot_area > 0
),
-- compute average per state-year for subplot and macroplot
avg_subplot AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    state_name,
    AVG(subplot_area) AS avg_subplot_area
  FROM valid_subplot
  GROUP BY inventory_year, state_code, state_name
),
avg_macroplot AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    state_name,
    AVG(macroplot_area) AS avg_macroplot_area
  FROM valid_macroplot
  GROUP BY inventory_year, state_code, state_name
),
-- pick the state with largest average for each year and type
max_subplot AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_year,
    'subplot' AS plot_type,
    ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(state_name, state_code, avg_subplot_area) ORDER BY avg_subplot_area DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)].*
  FROM avg_subplot
  GROUP BY inventory_year
),
max_macroplot AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_year,
    'macroplot' AS plot_type,
    ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(state_name, state_code, avg_macroplot_area) ORDER BY avg_macroplot_area DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)].*
  FROM avg_macroplot
  GROUP BY inventory_year

-- final unioned result: year, plot type, state, avg size
SELECT
  inventory_year AS year,
  plot_type,
  state_name AS state,
  IFNULL(avg_subplot_area, avg_macroplot_area) AS average_size
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM max_subplot
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM max_macroplot

ORDER BY year, plot_type DESC

pollutant_monthly_scaled_view AS (
SELECT
  -- month as YYYY-MM (string) derived from date_local month
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)) AS month,

  -- pm10 monthly average (carry through arithmetic_mean aggregated by month)
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'PM10' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) AS pm10_monthly_avg,

  -- pm25_fine (PM2.5 FRM) monthly average
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'PM2.5 FRM' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) AS pm25_frm_monthly_avg,

  -- pm25_nonfrm monthly average
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'PM2.5 Non-FRM' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) AS pm25_nonfrm_monthly_avg,

  -- VOC monthly average (assumed parameter_name 'VOC' in source)
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'VOC' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) AS voc_monthly_avg,

  -- SO2 monthly average scaled by 10 (assumed parameter_name 'SO2')
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'SO2' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) * 10.0 AS so2_monthly_avg_scaled,

  -- Lead monthly average scaled by 100 (assumed parameter_name 'Lead')
  AVG(CASE WHEN parameter_name = 'Lead' THEN arithmetic_mean END) OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH))) * 100.0 AS lead_monthly_avg_scaled
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
)
SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', m) AS month,
  ROUND(pm10_monthly_avg, 6) AS pm10_monthly_avg,
  ROUND(pm25_frm_monthly_avg, 6) AS pm25_frm_monthly_avg,
  ROUND(pm25_nonfrm_monthly_avg, 6) AS pm25_nonfrm_monthly_avg,
  ROUND(voc_monthly_avg, 6) AS voc_monthly_avg,
  ROUND(so2_monthly_avg_scaled, 6) AS so2_monthly_avg_scaled,
  ROUND(lead_monthly_avg_scaled, 6) AS lead_monthly_avg_scaled
FROM (
  -- compute monthly averages per pollutant from daily records for 2020, then reshape to one row per month
  WITH
    filtered AS (
      SELECT
        table_name,
        date_local,
        arithmetic_mean
      FROM daily_pollutant_records_ca
      WHERE date_local BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2020-12-31'
        AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
    ),
    monthly AS (
      SELECT
        table_name,
        DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS m,
        AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_arith_mean
      FROM filtered
      GROUP BY table_name, m
    ),
    pm10 AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean AS pm10_monthly_avg
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'pm10_daily_summary'
    ),
    pm25_frm AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean AS pm25_frm_monthly_avg
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'pm25_frm_daily_summary'
    ),
    pm25_nonfrm AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean AS pm25_nonfrm_monthly_avg
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary'
    ),
    voc AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean AS voc_monthly_avg
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'voc_daily_summary'
    ),
    so2 AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean * 10.0 AS so2_monthly_avg_scaled
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'so2_daily_summary'
    ),
    lead AS (
      SELECT m, avg_arith_mean * 100.0 AS lead_monthly_avg_scaled
      FROM monthly
      WHERE table_name = 'lead_daily_summary'
    ),
    months AS (
      -- ensure we have a row for each month present in any pollutant
      SELECT m FROM pm10 UNION DISTINCT
      SELECT m FROM pm25_frm UNION DISTINCT
      SELECT m FROM pm25_nonfrm UNION DISTINCT
      SELECT m FROM voc UNION DISTINCT
      SELECT m FROM so2 UNION DISTINCT
      SELECT m FROM lead
    )
  -- left join all pollutant monthly results onto the union of months
  SELECT
    months.m,
    pm10.pm10_monthly_avg,
    pm25_frm.pm25_frm_monthly_avg,
    pm25_nonfrm.pm25_nonfrm_monthly_avg,
    voc.voc_monthly_avg,
    so2.so2_monthly_avg_scaled,
    lead.lead_monthly_avg_scaled
  FROM months
  LEFT JOIN pm10 USING(m)

),

-- We will match proteome.sample_submitter_id (from mapping) to RNA sample_submitter_id (GDC sample barcode)
-- Some proteome rows may have sample_submitter_id NULL; also try matching aliquot submitter ids.
joined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.sample_submitter_id, p.mapping_aliquot_submitter_id, p.aliquot_submitter_id) AS submitter_id,
    COALESCE(r.sample_submitter_id, r.sample_barcode) AS rna_submitter_id,
    p.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    p.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein_log2ratio,
    r.log_fpkm_plus1 AS log_fpkm_plus1,

  FROM
    joined
  GROUP BY

    sample_type_name

  GROUP BY
    sample_type_name

  average_correlation,
  genes_count
FROM
  filtered_and_averaged

  sample_type_name

-- Mitelman uses CytoConverted to determine gains/losses per RefNo/CaseNo; we compute per-chromosome frequencies.
WITH
-- Mitelman cases filtered for morphology and topology
mit_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(RefNo AS INT64) AS RefNo, CaseNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),

-- Use CytoConverted to classify simple whole-chromosome or arm-level gains/losses based on start/end covering chromosome
-- Here we interpret Type field for gains/amplifications/losses/deletions if available; otherwise infer by CellsPresent >0 as aberration
mit_cn_events AS (
  SELECT
    mc.RefNo,
    cc.Chr AS Chromosome,
    LOWER(cc.Type) AS Type,
    -- Normalize common type labels
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%amp%' THEN 'amp'
      WHEN LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%gain%' OR LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%dup%' THEN 'gain'
      WHEN LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%loss%' OR LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%del%' OR LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%-%' THEN 'loss'
      WHEN LOWER(cc.Type) LIKE '%del%' THEN 'del'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS AberrationType
  FROM mit_cases mc
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
    ON mc.RefNo = cc.RefNo
  WHERE cc.Chr IS NOT NULL AND cc.Chr != ''
),

-- Count Mitelman denominators (number of cases per chromosome in cohort)
mit_denoms AS (
  SELECT
    Chromosome,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RefNo) AS Mit_Cases
  FROM mit_cn_events
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),

-- Count Mitelman aberration occurrences per chromosome and type
mit_counts AS (
  SELECT
    Chromosome,
    AberrationType,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RefNo) AS Mit_Abn_Cases
  FROM mit_cn_events
  WHERE AberrationType IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY Chromosome, AberrationType
),

-- Mitelman frequencies
mit_freq AS (
  SELECT
    m.Chromosome,
    m.AberrationType,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(m.Mit_Abn_Cases, d.Mit_Cases) AS Mit_Freq
  FROM mit_counts m
  JOIN mit_denoms d USING(Chromosome)

-- Assume TCGA_CNV_Freq table exists with matching Chromosome and AberrationType, Frequency as TCGA_Freq

  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.TCGA_CNV_Freq`

  SELECT

    mf.AberrationType,
    mf.Mit_Freq,
    tf.TCGA_Freq
  FROM mit_freq mf
  JOIN tcga_freq tf
    ON mf.Chromosome = tf.Chromosome

-- Since each Chromosome+AberrationType typically has one Mit_Freq and one TCGA_Freq,

-- If band-level TCGA data exists, it should be in TCGA_CNV_Freq with Band included. Attempt band join if present.

  SELECT Chromosome, COALESCE(Band, '') AS Band, LOWER(AberrationType) AS AberrationType, Frequency AS TCGA_Freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.TCGA_CNV_Freq`
  WHERE IFNULL(Band,'') <> ''

mitelman_band AS (
  -- Try to map CytoConverted entries to bands using Chr + approximate Start/End mapping by band table if available.

  SELECT NULL AS Chromosome, NULL AS Band, NULL AS AberrationType, NULL AS Mit_Freq WHERE FALSE

combined_band AS (
  -- Prefer band-level comparison if available in TCGA; otherwise fall back to chromosome-level joined pairs.
  SELECT
    j.Chromosome,
    j.AberrationType,
    j.Mit_Freq,
    j.TCGA_Freq
  FROM joined j

-- Final aggregation: compute Pearson correlation and p-value per Chromosome and AberrationType.
SELECT
  Chromosome,
  AberrationType,
  -- Use correlated pairs across entries per chromosome & aberration type.
  -- We compute correlation using ARRAY_AGG and statistical functions.
  CORR(Mit_Freq, TCGA_Freq) AS pearson_r,

        SELECT

            SELECT
              -- approximate using normal cdf: Phi(|t|)
              0.5 * (1 + ERF(ABS(t) / SQRT(2)))
            FROM (SELECT IFNULL(
              SAFE_DIVIDE(r * SQRT(SAFE_CAST((n-2) AS FLOAT64) / (1 - r*r)), 1),
              0
            ) AS t, r, n) 
          ))
        FROM (SELECT CORR(Mit_Freq, TCGA_Freq) AS r, COUNT(1) AS n)
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS p_value,
  COUNT(1) AS n_pairs
FROM combined_band
GROUP BY Chromosome, AberrationType
HAVING COUNT(1) >= 5
ORDER BY Chromosome, AberrationType

-- 3. FDIC bank locations in Colorado with point geometry
co_banks AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT(fdic_certificate_number, '_', branch_number) AS bank_id,

    branch_city,
    zip_code AS bank_zip,
    SAFE_CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY) AS bank_point_geom, -- placeholder if no point column

  WHERE state_name = 'CO' OR state = 'CO' OR state_name = 'Colorado'

-- 4. Assign each bank to the centroid point of its ZIP polygon (proxy for bank location when no point available)
bank_points AS (
  SELECT
    b.* REPLACE(ST_CENTROID(z.zip_geom) AS bank_geom)
  FROM co_banks b
  LEFT JOIN co_zips z
  ON b.bank_zip = z.zip_code
),

-- 5. Count banks per block group by spatial join using ST_INTERSECTS of bank point with blockgroup geom.
-- If bank point falls into block group, count it. This aligns banks to block groups directly.
banks_per_blockgroup AS (
  SELECT
    bg.blockgroup_geo_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bp.bank_id) AS banks_in_bg
  FROM co_blockgroups bg
  JOIN bank_points bp
  ON ST_INTERSECTS(bp.bank_geom, bg.bg_geom)
  GROUP BY bg.blockgroup_geo_id

zip_bg_overlaps AS (
  SELECT
    z.zip_code,
    bg.blockgroup_geo_id,
    -- intersection geometry
    ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_geom, bg.bg_geom) AS inter_geom
  FROM co_zips z
  JOIN co_blockgroups bg
  ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_geom, bg.bg_geom)
),

-- 7. Calculate overlap ratio: intersection area / blockgroup area
zip_bg_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    zbo.zip_code,
    zbo.blockgroup_geo_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(zbo.inter_geom), bg.bg_area_m2) AS overlap_ratio
  FROM zip_bg_overlaps zbo
  JOIN co_blockgroups bg
  USING(blockgroup_geo_id)
  WHERE ST_ISEMPTY(zbo.inter_geom) = FALSE
),

-- 8. Estimate bank counts per block group contributed from each ZIP by distributing banks within ZIP to overlapping blockgroups.
-- First get total banks per ZIP (by matching bank_points bank_zip to zip_code)
banks_per_zip AS (
  SELECT
    z.zip_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bp.bank_id) AS banks_in_zip
  FROM co_zips z
  LEFT JOIN bank_points bp
  ON z.zip_code = bp.bank_zip
  GROUP BY z.zip_code
),

zip_bg_bank_allocation AS (
  SELECT
    r.zip_code,
    r.blockgroup_geo_id,
    r.overlap_ratio,
    bzp.banks_in_zip,
    SAFE_MULTIPLY(r.overlap_ratio, bzp.banks_in_zip) AS banks_allocated_to_bg
  FROM zip_bg_ratios r
  LEFT JOIN banks_per_zip bzp
  USING(zip_code)
),

-- 9. For each ZIP, compute the maximum number of banks allocated to any single overlapping block group (per method request)
zip_max_banks_per_bg AS (
  SELECT
    zip_code,
    MAX(banks_allocated_to_bg) AS max_banks_in_a_blockgroup
  FROM zip_bg_bank_allocation
  GROUP BY zip_code
)

-- 10. Return the Colorado ZIP code with the highest concentration (highest max_banks_in_a_blockgroup).
SELECT
  zmp.zip_code,
  zmp.max_banks_in_a_blockgroup
FROM zip_max_banks_per_bg zmp
ORDER BY zmp.max_banks_in_a_blockgroup DESC
LIMIT 1
